title: macOS 27 guest on 2.6.0: typed text, scroll and drag from 'input' have no effect, and they worked on 2.5.0
body:
## Summary

On TestAnyware 2.6.0, a macOS 27 guest ignores typed text, mouse-wheel scrolls and scroll-bar drags that `testanyware input` sends. Screenshots and the accessibility tree still work. The same flows passed on 2.5.0 two days earlier.

## Environment

- Host: macOS 27.0 (Darwin 27.0.0), arm64. `testanyware` 2.6.0 from the Homebrew tap, installed on 26 October at 15:53. The previous version was 2.5.0.
- Guest: a clone of `testanyware-golden-macos-27`, macOS 27.0.1 (26A434), arm64. The display is 1920x1080.
- The command `testanyware vm start --platform macos --id <id>` started the guest. It had no `--base` option.

## What happened

A client script opens a settings window in the guest. The window holds a text field, five checkboxes and a button below the fold. The script scrolls the window, so that the button comes on screen. The script stopped with this message:

```text
grant-label at y=411.0 moved to y=411.0 under --dy -10; towards the end is --dy 10
FAILED: scrolling did not bring .role=="button" and .label=="Create Grant" on screen
```

The same failure came four times in a row. I kept the guest running after the fourth failure and tried input by hand. All commands exited 0 and printed their usual confirmation line.

| Command | Result in the guest |
|---|---|
| `input scroll 280 395 --dy=-30` (three times) | The window content did not move. |
| `input scroll 240 500 --dy=-40` (four times) | The window content did not move. |
| `input scroll 240 400 --window "Koine Settings" --dy 30` | The content moved 10 pixels down and stayed there. It did not move again. |
| `input drag 511 300 511 700` (the scroll-bar thumb) | Nothing changed. |
| `input type "abc"` after a click in the focused text field | `agent snapshot` still reports `textfield "Client label" [focused] value=""`. The screenshot has no text. |

The window and its process were alive. The app used 12% CPU in the guest, and `agent snapshot` and `screen capture` answered normally.

## Expected

Typed text reaches the focused field. A scroll event moves a scrollable view, as it did on 2.5.0.

## Not known

- I did not test `agent` actions that do not use VNC, so I do not know whether only the VNC input path is broken.
- I did not test a macOS 26 guest or a Linux guest.
- I did not test 2.5.0 again, so I cannot name 2.6.0 as the cause. The version change is the only difference that I found. The date also changed between the two runs.
- Issue 2 describes a VNC fault on a macOS 27 host. In this case the guest did not crash. I do not know whether they share a cause.

## Reproduce

1. Run `testanyware vm start --platform macos --id probe` on a macOS 27 host with 2.6.0.
2. Open any window in the guest that has a text field and a scrollable area.
3. Run `testanyware input type "abc" --vm probe` and `testanyware input scroll 280 395 --dy=-30 --vm probe`.
4. Run `testanyware agent snapshot --vm probe` and `testanyware screen capture --vm probe -o after.png`.
5. Compare the field value and the scroll position with their values before step 3.

## Proposed checks for a fix

- Add a live check that types into a text field and reads the value back through `agent snapshot`.
- Add a live check that scrolls a view taller than its window. It reads the position of one element before and after.
- Run both checks on every macOS guest version that the release supports.
